accessibility.title: Automatic production release handoff
accessibility.description: A successful same-repository main build publishes an immutable release candidate. A guarded handoff validates its exact metadata before dispatching it to protected staging, qualification, VPS production, and Vercel production steps; a Vercel promotion failure triggers VPS rollback.

review_notes: Automated merge documentation; human review is not claimed.
The record is limited to the supplied merged-change evidence.
Simple and Technical pages describe the same safety boundaries.
PR #541 documents a guarded automatic production release handoff, protected downstream release stages, migration failure behavior, and the Vercel-promotion VPS rollback path.
